fire: Prairie chickens nest in the sandsage country of western Kansas.
Grazing on the sands near the river slowly changed the plant cover.
The drifting sands buried the old road every winter.
Tourists walked across the warm sands toward the lighthouse.
Oil companies have mined the tar sands of Alberta for decades.
Shifting sands made the harbour mouth dangerous for large boats.
The caravan crossed the red sands before nightfall.
Children built forts on the white sands of the lagoon.
